title: Diagnose the 2 LCLI-630 release-window-guard test failures on macos-14 (not blocking 0.14.2)
description: Found during LCLI-776 sampling (2026-10-31). On macos-14-arm64 20260831.0302.1 (diag/LCLI-776-macos-14 e8e00597; runs 41175803187, 41175809532, 41175817202) ci.yml's macOS leg never wedged but failed the same two tests every time: test/lcli630-release-window-guard.test.ts:213, expect(r.code).toBe(0), Expected 0, Received 1, for the 1800 and 999999999 visibility-wait cases (a visible package gets its content check). The log does not show the script stderr, so the cause is NOT diagnosed. Ruled by opum-doc on ODOC-556 as its own task that does not block 0.14.2. Why it matters: macos-14 is the one label that has not wedged in 3 of 3 runs, so fixing these makes it a candidate for the LCLI-776 return path.
